trigger: Power-plant permit applications in the latest complete month reach half the 2025 monthly median
meaning: Texas buyers file again and the 13.6-month delay starts to shorten

trigger: Texas share of the Aug 2025 gas cohort still slipped falls below 30%
meaning: Delayed Texas grid gas comes online and the slip finding weakens

trigger: Gas turbines above 5 MW imported over the trailing four quarters fall below 167 (half of 333)
meaning: Rival imported supply stops building during the delay

trigger: An FTAI filing names a Mod-1 or J&F order amount other than the $1.465bn order
meaning: A second purchase order lifts the 58-unit cap behind $0 Power EBITDA from Q3 2028

trigger: Gensets from China into Houston in the trailing three months exceed zero
meaning: Jereh-route gensets keep landing ahead of Mod-1

trigger: A Department of Energy or Commerce rule or proposed rule on foreign-adversary equipment is published
meaning: The ban risk dated for about 24 Dec 2026 arrives
